chooseToContinue: Choose a role in the sidebar
entryHelp: Choose your role each time you enter Performance mode.
brandSubtitle: The Platform for Network Digital Score
hostWelcomeHelp: The host runs the project and provides an entry for other devices.
clientWelcomeHelp: Enter the host’s performance address or choose a recent host.
projectDesc: Perform with hand pose, tilt and sound parameters. Enable the inputs you need.
projectHint: Load the project to provide an entry for performers.
hostNotice: Selecting another project keeps the current performance running.
addressHint: Connect to the same performance network as the host.
disconnectHelp: Keep the score open while the connection recovers.
scoreSubtitle: Choose your inputs. Capture and inference run on this device.
waitingHelp: The page is open. The project decides whether this device is accepted.
prototypeHelp: In-memory demo only. No network, media or real project access.
variantHelpA: Hover to see the target. Click twice while idle. During a performance, the button asks you to leave first.
creationHint: Leave the local performance before entering Creation. This prototype does not expand that workspace.
settingsHint: Existing settings entry. This prototype does not change app or system settings.
importHint: Existing project entry. This prototype does not read files.
invalidAddress: Enter a complete HTTP or HTTPS address without credentials.
prototypeNote: Exclusive roles · Choose on entry · Embedded score
hostAbout: Run a project on this computer, manage its audio, and provide an entry for other devices.
clientAbout: Join the host’s local performance, view the score and enable inputs on this device.
nodeNameHelp: Clients will identify this host by this name.
nodeNamePlaceholder: Choose a name for this host
nodeNameRequired: Set a node name before starting a local performance.
unknownHelp: This project does not report acceptance. An open page does not confirm it.
changedHelp: The previous score is closed and its media are released. Confirm before loading the new project.
endedHelp: Participation has ended and media are released. Explicitly rejoin after the host starts a new performance.
hostChangedTitle: This address belongs to another host
hostChangedHelp: The original host record is preserved. Confirm the current host before saving its record and opening a score.
incompatibleHelp: The host does not provide a compatible connection protocol. Ask the host to upgrade before joining.
refreshHelp: Reloading interrupts this device’s performance; web storage is retained.
portAvoidedHelp: Preferred ports were occupied. The App selected available ports. Share the current address.
portStableHelp: The App manages ports and keeps them unchanged during a performance.
hostConflictHelp: This project does not support runtime port assignment and has not started. Resolve the conflict and retry, or select another project.
hostConflictStill: The example ports are still occupied. The project has not started.
projectIncompatibleHelp: The Host connection protocol is supported, but this project’s page connections need adaptation. Ask the Host to adapt the project, then retry.
projectIssueReason: The performer page connects to a fixed address instead of following its current page origin.
projectStillIncompatible: The example project still needs adaptation. No score has been opened.
unreachableHelp: Check the performance network and the Host’s current address, then retry. Recent connections and web storage are retained.
